title: Report open-task evidence pointers that left the checkout
body:
Open tasks cite agent-state evidence under `.krn/runs/` that is no longer in the checkout. On 2026-11-08, 11 such references in open tasks: 7 missing locally, 4 of them only in the recovery copy (~/recovery-runs/krn/active/krn), 3 gone. Resolving t-1hg9s06 cost a filesystem-wide search because its body pointed at a removed `.krn/runs/claude/eval-arm/deliver/override-beafe1f.md`.
Acceptance: a repository check the lead runs at resume lists every open-task `.krn/runs/` reference that is missing, with the recovery-copy path when one exists, and exits non-zero while any is listed; the 7 current misses are resolved by quoting the needed evidence into the task body or by closing the task; the check then prints zero misses.

2026-11-08 evidence: t-eya2kzf's body pointed at .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/repo-hygiene/disk-survey.txt (written 2026-11-01); the file was gone when the next lead resumed the task a week later, costing one dead lookup before a fresh survey.
